{{Top|ca|leg}}
A '''scanoven''' was a device. Multiple scanovens were located in the galley of the ''[[Celestial (starship)|Celestial]]'', a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]]. Sometime during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and the Rebel Alliance, the ''Celestial''<nowiki>'</nowiki>s [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] malfunctioned and the ship fell into [[otherspace]], a realm between [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] and [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="Otherspace">[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]</ref>

{{RPG|[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]}}
Some [[Time/Legends|time]] later, a group of Rebels&mdash;who were intending to rendezvous with the ''Celestial'' in realspace&mdash;also accidentally entered otherspace in their attempts to escape from an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and its complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]]. They boarded the ''Celestial'' and came across the scanovens in the ship's galley while searching the ship for clues to its fate.<ref name="Otherspace" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Scanovens appeared in the [[1989]] [[West End Games]] campaign book [[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. The player character rebels may not necessarily explore the galley of the ''Celestial''.<ref name="Otherspace" />
